background: HSBC Bank plc is the non-ring-fenced UK bank of HSBC, housing the group's European corporate and investment banking, markets and private banking, funded by corporate and institutional deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Fitch rates the bank AA after its upgrade on 12 May 2026, S&P A+ and Moody's A1, with S&P and now Moody's on positive outlook. Capital is mixed against UK majors, with CET1 of 17.1% in the top quarter but leverage of 4.1% in the bottom quarter, and liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 139% and NSFR of 112% both in the bottom quarter. Every ratio has fallen since 30 Jun 2025: CET1 by 2.3 points, leverage by 1.1 points, LCR by 15 points and NSFR by 5 points (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged items, on 18 Sep 2026, are Moody's positive outlooks on its deposit and issuer ratings, alongside a lost foreclosure claim of no credit significance.
